name: sf-devops
description: Generic, settings-driven Salesforce CI/CD workflow — 1-click story management, pipeline status, environment promotion, and an org-per-branch 2GP packaging release gate

sfDevops.gitProvider.description: Git hosting provider for pull requests and pipeline status. "bitbucket" and "github" are implemented; other values fall back to Bitbucket with a warning.

sfDevops.repoWorkspace.description: Workspace/organization slug of the Git repo (Bitbucket workspace). Falls back to the deprecated sfDevops.bitbucketWorkspace if unset.

sfDevops.repoSlug.description: Repository slug of the Git repo. Falls back to the deprecated sfDevops.bitbucketRepoSlug if unset.

sfDevops.bitbucketWorkspace.description: Deprecated — use sfDevops.repoWorkspace instead. Kept for backward compatibility.

sfDevops.bitbucketRepoSlug.description: Deprecated — use sfDevops.repoSlug instead. Kept for backward compatibility.

sfDevops.roles.description: The full set of role names your team uses. Reference these names in sfDevops.environments[].requiredRole. Default model: Developer (use the app), Lead (everything except Prod promote), Admin (all access, including config/setup and Prod).

sfDevops.role.description: Deprecated bootstrap default only — the real, in-effect role is managed via the "Change Role" action in the Current Story panel (password-gated for Lead/Admin, stored outside this setting). This value is just the starting role before anyone has ever changed it that way.

sfDevops.baseBranch.description: Branch new feature branches are cut from, and the branch staleness/sync checks compare against (e.g. "main").

sfDevops.devBranch.description: Deprecated — the first entry of sfDevops.environments now defines this branch. Kept for backward compatibility with 1.x settings.
sfDevops.devBranch.deprecationMessage: Set the branch on the first entry of sfDevops.environments instead.

sfDevops.featureBranchTemplate.description: Template for feature branch names. {storyId} is replaced with the story/ticket ID.

sfDevops.promotionBranchTemplate.description: Template for "Promote" branch names. {storyId} and {env} are replaced.

sfDevops.validateBranchTemplate.description: Template for "Validate Only" branch names. {storyId} and {env} are replaced.

sfDevops.environments.description: The full deployment pipeline, in order. The FIRST entry is published straight from the feature branch (no PR) — e.g. "dev". Every later entry is reached via a promotion/validate branch + pull request. Each entry may be a plain environment name (legacy shorthand) or an object: { name, label?, branch? (defaults to name), icon? (a VS Code codicon id), requiredRole? (role name from sfDevops.roles needed to run Promote into this environment — Validate Only is always unrestricted), coverageGate? (true = the Apex coverage check must pass before promoting into this environment) }.

name.description: Environment identifier, also used as the git branch name unless "branch" is set.

label.description: Display label. Defaults to the uppercased name.

branch.description: Git branch name for this environment, if different from "name".

icon.description: VS Code codicon id shown in the Environments tree view.

requiredRole.description: Role (from sfDevops.roles) required to Promote into this environment.

coverageGate.description: Require the Apex coverage gate to pass before promoting into this environment.

orgAlias.description: sf CLI alias/username of the org this environment deploys to. Purely informational/reference today — day-to-day deploys still happen via the CI pipeline triggered by the PR merge.

deployTestLevel.description: Apex test level used by the Deployment Dashboard's Deploy/Validate actions for this environment. Defaults to RunRelevantTests (only tests Salesforce determines relevant to the deployed components — pairs naturally with the Dashboard's file-selection-based deploys).

signoffGate.description: True = a human sign-off must be recorded on THIS environment (via the Current Story panel) before the story can be promoted to whatever comes after it — e.g. QA sign-off before UAT.

isProd.description: Marks this environment as Prod for safety gates (e.g. the Deployment Dashboard's auto-deploy-after-validate never applies here, regardless of the checkbox). Defaults to true when name is "prod" — set this explicitly if your production environment uses a different name.

locked.description: When true, blocks all promotions and deploys into this environment for all roles including Admin. Use for emergency stops.

sfDevops.terminalStageMessage.description: Message shown once a story has been merged into the last configured environment. {lastEnvLabel} is replaced with that environment's label.
sfDevops.terminalStageMessage.default: Story deployed up to {lastEnvLabel}. Anything beyond this stage is handled outside this extension.

sfDevops.ticketSystem.description: The ticketing system story IDs come from. Purely descriptive (used in prompt text) except when "none", which skips format validation entirely.

sfDevops.ticketKeyPattern.description: Regex (without slashes) used to recognize a story/ticket key when extracting one from a branch name (e.g. "IB-123"). New story IDs are accepted as free text and are not validated against this pattern. Defaults to a Jira-shaped key (PROJECT-123), or one derived from sfDevops.jiraProjectKey if that's set.

sfDevops.jiraProjectKey.description: Legacy shorthand: if set and sfDevops.ticketKeyPattern is empty, the pattern becomes "<jiraProjectKey>-\\d+".

sfDevops.ticketBaseUrl.description: URL template for linking to a ticket, e.g. "https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/{storyId}". Leave empty to hide the ticket link.

sfDevops.devOrgAlias.description: sf CLI alias/username of the dev (source) org used for the coverage check. Leave empty to use the CLI default org.

sfDevops.prodOrgAlias.description: sf CLI alias/username of the production org (the "main" branch target). Reference/informational only — prod is deployed by a separate DevOps team, not by this extension.

sfDevops.coverageThreshold.description: Minimum per-class Apex code coverage (%) required before a story with Apex can be promoted into the environment(s) with coverageGate: true.

sfDevops.coverageTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the Apex test run to finish before timing out.

sfDevops.deployTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (in seconds) for a single Deployment Dashboard deploy/validate run.

sfDevops.enableVerboseLogs.description: When enabled, the 'Salesforce DevOps' output channel also prints every raw git/sf command this extension runs (with its full arguments), the raw CLI JSON response, and job/deploy/test-run IDs with their status — on top of the normal plain-language narration. Off by default: much noisier, meant for troubleshooting.

sfDevops.sourceRootFolder.description: Salesforce DX source root folder name (the package directory in sfdx-project.json), used to detect Apex classes and other metadata changes.

sfDevops.staleStoryThresholdDays.description: Days with no new commits before a story is flagged as stale in the Current Story panel and Pipeline view. Set to 0 to disable stale detection.

sfDevops.auditLogRetentionDays.description: Auto-trim audit log entries older than this many days on extension startup. Set to 0 to disable auto-trim.

sfDevops.staleBranchThreshold.description: Number of commits behind the base branch before the extension warns you to sync.

sfDevops.fallbackRefreshSeconds.description: How often the Story Progress sidebar re-checks state on its own, in seconds. This is only a safety net — real branch switches and file changes are already picked up live, so you rarely need to lower this; raise it (or set it very high) to reduce background work.

sfDevops.packageBaselineBranch.description: 2GP Release Gate: the packaging baseline branch. "Prepare 2GP Beta from UAT" cuts its beta branch from here and opens its PR back to it.

sfDevops.packagingSourceBranch.description: 2GP Release Gate: the branch compared against sfDevops.packageBaselineBranch to decide what's changed. Defaults to the "uat" entry's branch in sfDevops.environments if empty.

sfDevops.packagingRequiredRole.description: Role (from sfDevops.roles) required to run "SF-Ops: Prepare 2GP Beta from UAT". Leave empty to allow any role.

sfDevops.packaging.description: Settings for the 2GP Packaging Release Gate — how changed metadata between sfDevops.packagingSourceBranch and sfDevops.packageBaselineBranch is segregated and packaged.

packageName.description: The "package" value of the packageDirectories entry in sfdx-project.json to version-bump. Leave empty to use the first entry that has a versionNumber.

sourceBase.description: Standard flat-structure source root compared between branches.

managedTarget.description: Destination folder (on the 2gp-beta branch) for metadata not matched by patchOverrides or excludedMetadata.

unmanagedTarget.description: Destination folder (on the 2gp-beta branch) for metadata matched by patchOverrides.

docsDirectory.description: Folder the generated vX.Y.Z-RELEASE-NOTES.md is written to.

patchOverrides.description: Glob patterns (relative to sourceBase) for components that must go to unmanagedTarget instead of managedTarget — patch overrides, server-error workarounds, custom configs.

excludedMetadata.description: Glob patterns (relative to sourceBase) for components excluded from the 2GP beta entirely — copied to neither bucket.

devHubOrgAlias.description: sf CLI alias/username of the Dev Hub used for this package. Reference setting — not yet invoked by "Prepare 2GP Beta from UAT" itself.
